name: ISSO
goal: Attest AC-2 (Account Management) for prod-platform under FedRAMP Moderate — move it from Claimed to Attested.

steps.title: Open Assurance Room
steps.detail: Sees 274/323 attested, 22 claimed, 16 gaps. Locates AC-2 in Claimed group.

steps.title: Author implementation statement
steps.detail: Writes: 'Account lifecycle reviewed every 30 days.' Claim lands as ○ Claimed.

steps.title: Attach observations
steps.detail: Links Entra ID configuration export. Evidence lands as ⊢ Observed with digest.

steps.title: Run Attest
steps.detail: Ladder climbs: Discovery → Graph → Claim → Source → Signature → Transparency. 6/8 resolved.

steps.title: Witness checkpoint pending
steps.detail: Cannot complete — witness anchor not set. Claim stays Claimed → attesting, not Attested.

steps.title: Anchor witness checkpoint
steps.detail: Sets witness checkpoint. Ladder rung 7 resolves.

steps.title: Evaluate policy
steps.detail: Policy ref evaluated against fedramp-moderate-attest. Ladder completes.

steps.title: Claim transitions to Attested
steps.detail: ◆ Attested. Coverage numerator increments. Violet + sealed chamfer earned.

name: 3PAO Assessor
goal: Independently verify the AC-2 proof chain — not trust the ISSO's assertion, re-run verification locally.

steps.title: Receive export bundle
steps.detail: Receives X-0194 from prod-platform. Enters as imported-unverified.

steps.title: Run VerifyClaim
steps.detail: Re-runs claim verification locally. Sender assertion is not sufficient.

steps.title: Run VerifyEvidence
steps.detail: Verifies evidence digests against source references. Checks redaction state.

steps.title: Digest mismatch on one artifact
steps.detail: Evidence E-443 digest does not match source ref. That evidence is quarantined.

steps.title: Request corrected evidence
steps.detail: Requests re-export of E-443 from ISSO. Quarantine trace opened.

steps.title: Re-verify corrected evidence
steps.detail: Corrected E-443 arrives. VerifyClaim + VerifyEvidence pass. Digest reconciles.

steps.title: Produce assessment results
steps.detail: Finding F-018: AC-2 satisfied. 4 observations, 3 signed artifacts. Policy passed.

steps.title: Sign and return findings
steps.detail: Returns signed assessment-results to prod-platform. Receiver-verified.

name: CISO / Authorizing Official
goal: See honest coverage, accept residual risk, and authorize the release to FedRAMP PMO.

steps.title: Open Assurance Room
steps.detail: Sees 274/323 attested (85%). 16 gaps, 3 conflicts, 2 quarantined. No 'compliant %'.

steps.title: Review attestation quality
steps.detail: 271 signed, 240 witnessed, 268 transparency-logged, 236 policy-evaluated. Gaps visible.

steps.title: Review gaps
steps.detail: SC-7 Boundary Protection: 1 inferred, 0 proofs. Required by baseline. Honest absence, not alarm.

steps.title: Review conflicts
steps.detail: Two competing statements: 7 days vs 30 days. Human resolution required — not auto-merged.

steps.title: Accept residual risk for gaps
steps.detail: Accepts SC-7 as residual risk with POA&M. Gap becomes tracked debt, not hidden failure.

steps.title: Create snapshot v3
steps.detail: Seals 274 attested + 16 gaps + 3 conflicts into snapshot. Manifest hash computed.

steps.title: Authorize release v0.1.0
steps.detail: Signs release to FedRAMP PMO. Redaction applied. Verification script included.

name: Platform Engineer
goal: Link the SBOM and Trivy scanner results to CM, RA, SA, SI controls for release 3.8.1.

steps.title: Generate SBOM
steps.detail: CycloneDX SBOM generated: 1,284 components. Digest computed. Lands as ⊢ Observed — not attested.

steps.title: Run Trivy scan
steps.detail: 0 critical, 4 high, 18 medium. SBOM linked, VEX partial. Digest computed.

steps.title: Link SBOM to controls
steps.detail: Links to CM, RA, SA, SI. Back-matter resource created in OSCAL.

steps.title: Stale scan detected
steps.detail: Scan collected 47 days ago, freshness policy is 30 days. Cannot support current release claim.

steps.title: Run new scan
steps.detail: Re-runs Trivy against current image. Freshness restored. New digest computed.

steps.title: Open VEX for high findings
steps.detail: Reviews 4 high findings. Marks not_affected with justification for 2. Creates POA&M for 2.

steps.title: Export evidence manifest
steps.detail: Exports SBOM + scan + VEX as evidence bundle linked to release 3.8.1.

name: Exchange Receiver
goal: Receive the prod-platform export bundle and verify it locally — never trust the sender's assertion.

steps.title: Receive inbound claim
steps.detail: Receives AC-4 claim from prod-platform. Presented proofs: signature, transparency_log, witness_checkpoint.

steps.title: Run VerifyClaim locally
steps.detail: Re-runs claim verification. Sender state was attested — but local state starts as imported-unverified.

steps.title: Run VerifyEvidence locally
steps.detail: Verifies evidence digests. Checks disclosure class is respected.

steps.title: Digest reconciliation
steps.detail: Hashes match. Reconciliation by hash, not custody transfer.

steps.title: Disposition: Attested
steps.detail: ◆ Attested — independently verified. Accepted into local graph. Sender assertion was not sufficient.

steps.title: Receive second claim — fail
steps.detail: Receives SC-8 from Partner-C. Signature only, no transparency log. VerifyClaim fails.

steps.title: Quarantine failed import
steps.detail: ⊘ Quarantined. Digest mismatch. Not accepted into local graph. Request corrected evidence.

steps.title: Export verification receipt
steps.detail: Produces signed receipt documenting local verification of accepted + quarantined claims.

name: AI Tool Operator
goal: Run reg-to-OSCAL on EU AI Act Articles 9–15 and review the 41 inferred claims — none may skip to attested.

steps.title: Run reg-to-OSCAL generator
steps.detail: Model route: model-x / policy P-014. Input: EU AI Act Articles 9–15. Output: 41 inferred claims.

steps.title: Output lands as Inferred
steps.detail: All 41 claims land as ⇝ Inferred. DUX_002: generated AI output lands as inferred. No exceptions.

steps.title: Attempt to attest one claim
steps.detail: Blocked: generated claim cannot skip to attested. Human review is a state transition, not a comment.

steps.title: Review inferred claims
steps.detail: Reviews each claim against source text. Opens generation receipt for provenance check.

steps.title: Promote reviewed claims to Claimed
steps.detail: After human review, claims transition ⇝ Inferred → ○ Claimed. Review is a state transition.

steps.title: Attach evidence to support claims
steps.detail: Links AI-BOM and eval evidence. Claims move toward observed as evidence attaches.

steps.title: Export inferred-claims manifest
steps.detail: Exports manifest with model route receipt, prompt digest, context digest, and review trail.
